main_text.p: Attonita bibit aure cantus: Strepentis undæ quum prope rivulos, Aut in tenello gramine consident, Gaudentque concordes sonoris Pectinibus sociare voces. Hic ille certis ornat honoribus Vestris amicos fontibus, & sacras Queis ferre lauros, & sonare Grandiloquo dedit ore PHOEBVS Virtutis ingens quæ studium queant Puris iuventæ mentibus indere, & Præstare venturos tenaces Propositi melioris annos: Si digna veris laudibus efferant, Turpesque culpas, & vitium premant: Si dulce monstrent pro pudicis Coniugibus, PATRI Aque duras Obire mortes. Si iubeant suos Cultus SVPREMO reddere NVMINI: Ut cuncta[?] florescant per urbes Incolumi PIETATE fausta. Quid? Ille castas PALLADIS integræ Miratus artes promouet impiger, Suumque doctrinis nitorem

page.notes: The bold-looking capital words (PHOEBVS, PATRI, SVPREMO, NVMINI, PIETATE, PALLADIS) are printed in spaced roman capitals. "cuncta" is set oddly in print and is marked [?]. "Pectinibus" is uncertain in the scan. The right-hand show-through from the facing page is ignored. No page number or running head is printed.
